svg.title: PicoClaw pull-request lifecycle gates
svg.desc: Architecture and lifecycle diagram showing the user, PicoClaw components and agents, Git and GitHub, all fourteen decision points in the effective Default PR lifecycle gate profile, the five configurable stage formats, adaptive nudging, deferred work, publication, and the non-configurable hard-scope gate.

g.text: PR lifecycle gates · actors, agents, and Git effects
Effective built-in Default profile · 14 configurable decision points · ordered all-of stages · strict no-compatibility PR workspace
One provider snapshot, charter, findings set, correction history, gate ledger, and publication audit trail
Repository assignment selects a profile. Each decision point is an ordered ALL-OF workflow; a non-pass stops later stages.
Effective Default profile · every decision point
Default cards show their current stage type. Any configurable card can be replaced with an ordered combination of the five formats above.
provider · repo · PR · author · base · head
Workspace version + provider revision become CAS fences
Provider and ownership checks fail closed in domain logic
Immutable head snapshot returned to PicoClaw
One confirmed revision becomes the authority
Revision invalidates stale findings, gates, and publications
Checks every changed hunk against charter
Tracks novel/duplicate findings and later reward
Messages + corrections feed review and repair
Charter/head fenced; stale facts stay historical
A correction grants no Git or gate authority
Edit · split · merge · link existing issue
S2/S3 work is not silently implemented
Creates scoped reusable knowledge; never rewrites history
Edits only the pinned candidate for authorized findings
Prompt digest binds edit authority and shared corrections
Maps every real candidate hunk to scope + size
Configurable classification for otherwise allowable work
Remove + defer · revise charter · block — PASS is impossible
Checks bind to exact candidate SHA
Green evidence cannot excuse scope drift
Searches for missing and extra work
Fresh candidate + scope + validation are rechecked
Read-only marker / exact remote-head check; revise and defer are invalid
Every gate pins profile revision + subject digest + evidence; provider effects remain independently authorized.
